task.name: pick_marker_place_cup
task.description: Use the left arm to pick up the marker and place it in the purple cup.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the marker.
2. Grasp the marker with the left arm.
3. Move the left arm to align with the purple cup.
4. Release the gripper to place the marker into the purple cup.
